args.text:
MEMO TO: Ostrander CPA (Audit Engagement)
RE: PBC Request #14 - March 2026 Journal Entry Sample Support
DATE: April 3, 2026
FROM: David Murguia, Senior Accountant

Halvard Systems has processed your PBC request #14 dated April 2, 2026, requesting support for five sampled March 2026 journal entries. Below is our response:

ENTRIES WITH COMPLETE SUPPORT ATTACHED:

1. JE-00237 (March 5, 2026) - Pluralsight Team Training Licenses
   Amount: USD 1,850.00
   Account: 6320 Training & Conferences / 2000 Accounts Payable
   Support: Pluralsight invoice PL-7781 (DOC-0168) - vendor invoice dated 2026-03-05
   Status: ✓ Supported

2. JE-00298 (March 26, 2026) - Pinecrest Janitorial Services
   Amount: USD 2,240.00
   Account: 6120 Facilities & Cleaning / 2000 Accounts Payable
   Support: Pinecrest Janitorial invoice PJ-0326 (DOC-0199) - vendor invoice dated 2026-03-26
   Status: ✓ Supported

3. JE-00275 (March 19, 2026) - Ostrander CPA Interim Audit Fieldwork
   Amount: USD 6,000.00
   Account: 6510 Audit & Accounting Fees / 2000 Accounts Payable
   Support: Ostrander CPA invoice OC-2026-11 (DOC-0192) - vendor invoice dated 2026-03-19
   Status: ✓ Supported

4. JE-00288 (March 23, 2026) - Talentbridge Recruiting Placement Fee
   Amount: USD 4,500.00
   Account: 6030 Recruiting / 2000 Accounts Payable
   Support: Talentbridge Recruiting invoice TB-4410 (DOC-0198) - vendor invoice dated 2026-03-23
   Status: ✓ Supported

ENTRY LACKING SUPPORT:

5. JE-00293 (March 25, 2026) - Consulting Expense
   Amount: USD 4,800.00
   Account: 6520 Consulting Fees / 1000 Cash - Operating
   Description in ledger: "Consulting - K. Lindqvist"
   Bank match: Wire payment BT-US-0080 dated 2026-03-25 to K. Lindqvist
   Status: ✗ NO SUPPORTING DOCUMENTATION AVAILABLE

This entry presents a significant documentation gap. While the bank statement confirms a wire payment to K. Lindqvist on March 25, 2026, we do not have:
- A vendor invoice or bill
- A consulting services agreement or statement of work
- Time records, deliverables, or scope documentation
- Any other substantiating evidence of services rendered

This entry has been flagged for controller review (EXC-001). We cannot provide this entry to auditors without proper supporting documentation, as it does not meet our documentation standards.

Four of the five sampled entries (80%) are fully supported with vendor invoices. The one unsupported entry requires investigation and documentation retrieval before it can be provided to you.

Please advise if you require any additional clarification on the four supported entries or if you would like us to hold the response pending resolution of the unsupported entry.

Respectfully submitted,
David Murguia
Senior Accountant
Halvard Systems
